canonical_data: per-run in-memory iteration history (gaps, tool calls, findings, thoughts) and the generated Markdown report; no durable store
strengths: Loop of knowledge-gap check, tool selection, parallel tool agents, and observations is bounded by explicit iteration and time limits
A planner drafts a section outline and runs concurrent iterative researchers per section, with a proofreader merging the result
Model providers are configured per role (reasoning, main, fast) and include hosted APIs and local models
weaknesses: Research state lives in memory for one run, with no checkpointing or resume if a long parallel run fails
It does not ask clarifying questions or gate steps on a person, so the only human control is the up-front limits
The README's own TODO list still carries unchecked items for search providers, caching, a PDF parser, and local-file retrieval, and the last commit is dated December 2025
why_it_matters: A small, readable reference implementation of the gap-driven deep-research loop on the OpenAI Agents SDK, usable with non-OpenAI models.
